# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For this repository, preserve existing work, comments, pseudocode, and learning notes; do not implement pending exercises or replace solutions with optimized implementations; keep the existing .NET version; use beginner-friendly simple code; inspect before changes; do not commit or push without explicit approval; after approval summarize modified files and verification results.
- The repository separates concerns with `Program.cs` containing caller/demo methods and `Solutions.cs` containing the implemented solution methods; preserve this structure when explaining or modifying exercises.
